description: Provision a Google Cloud Networkservices NetworkServicesGateway via Config Connector. Fields mirror the networkservices.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 NetworkServicesGateway spec.

addresses.description:
Optional. Zero or one IPv4 or IPv6 address on which the Gateway will
 receive the traffic. When no address is provided, an IP from the subnetwork
 is allocated

 This field only applies to gateways of type 'SECURE_WEB_GATEWAY'.
 Gateways of type 'OPEN_MESH' listen on 0.0.0.0 for IPv4 and :: for IPv6.

description.description: Optional. A free-text description of the resource. Max length 1024 characters.

location.description: Immutable. The location for the resource.

ports.description: Required. One or more ports that the Gateway must receive traffic on. The proxy binds to the ports specified. Gateway listen on 0.0.0.0 on the ports specified below.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: Immutable. The Project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

scope.description: Immutable. Required. Immutable. Scope determines how configuration across multiple Gateway instances are merged. The configuration for multiple Gateway instances with the same scope will be merged as presented as a single coniguration to the proxy/load balancer. Max length 64 characters. Scope should start with a letter and can only have letters, numbers, hyphens.

serverTlsPolicyRef.description: Optional. A fully-qualified ServerTLSPolicy URL reference. Specifies how TLS traffic is terminated. If empty, TLS termination is disabled. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: string of the format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/serverTlsPolicies/{{value}}`, where {{value}} is the `name` field of a `NetworkSecurityServerTLSPolicy` resource.

name.description: The name of a NetworkSecurityServerTLSPolicy resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a NetworkSecurityServerTLSPolicy resource.

type.description: Immutable. Immutable. The type of the customer managed gateway. Possible values: TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, OPEN_MESH, SECURE_WEB_GATEWAY

title: GCP Networkservices NetworkServicesGateway
